rationale: A ring whose 2px stroke runs from -1.4 to 25.4: visibly clipped on all four sides. The content bbox ignores stroke width and int() truncates -0.4 to 0, so the bbox is exactly 0..24 and compactness.overflow stays silent (r=12.5 would have fired through the right edge only). Fix: grow every shape bbox by stroke-width/2 and use floor/ceil instead of int().
